mapper.sql: s.id, s.homework_id, s.student_user_id, s.course_id, s.answer_content, s.status, s.score, s.feedback, s.graded_by, s.version, s.submitted_time, s.graded_time, s.updated_time
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_homework_submission SET score = #{submission.score}, feedback = #{submission.feedback}, status = 'GRADED', graded_by = #{submission.gradedBy}, graded_time = #{submission.gradedTime}, updated_time = #{submission.updatedTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{submission.id} AND homework_id = #{submission.homeworkId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'GRADED')
